# Firebase JavaScript SDK 13.2.0

Downloaded from the official Google CDN on 2026-11-04:

- https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/13.2.0/firebase-app.js
- https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/13.2.0/firebase-auth.js

The auth module's app import was changed to `./firebase-app.js` to serve both files locally. License and copyright comments are retained in the distributed modules. No Analytics, Firestore or Storage SDK is included.

SDK source and licenses: https://github.com/firebase/firebase-js-sdk
